defs.def: to examine sth to see if it is correct, safe or acceptable 检查；审查；核查；检验

ex.s: Hire experts to check the records.
ex.t: 聘请专家核查记录。

ex.s: By checking on smells.
ex.t: 通过检查气味。

ex.s: It would work like this: An officer arriving at the scene of a crash could ask for the phones of the drivers and use the Textalyzer to check in the operating system for recent activity.
ex.t: 它会这样运作：到达车祸现场的警官可以要求司机交出手机，并用Textalyzer在操作系统里检查近期活动。

ex.s: Check the words in a dictionary.
ex.t: 在词典里查这些词。

ex.s: Check the words in a dictionary.
ex.t: 在词典里查这些词。

ex.s: Check the cupboard.
ex.t: 检查一下橱柜。

ex.s: Check their product.
ex.t: 检查他们的产品。

ex.s: To check and maintain fire prevention equipment．
ex.t: A．管道和烟雾探测器。

ex.s: Pahlsson and her husband  62   (search) the kitchen, checking every corner, but turned up nothing.
ex.t: 帕尔松和丈夫   62   （搜索）了厨房，检查每个角落，却一无所获。

ex.s: When will someone come to check the hot water?
ex.t: 什么时候会有人来检查热水？

ex.s: I checked my spelling.
ex.t: 我检查了我的拼写。

ex.s: I checked my spelling.
ex.t: 我检查了我的拼写。

ex.s: Years of experience in the industry - and failed attempts to use technology - have convinced him that the best way to check cattle is with a man on a horse.
ex.t: 多年的行业经验——以及使用技术却失败的尝试——让他确信，检查牛群最好的方式是用一个骑在马上的人。

ex.s: Sometimes she would look in and ask what we were reading — not to check but to know.
ex.t: 有时她会走进来问我们在读什么——不是为了检查而是为了了解。

ex.s: The use of drones in checking on power lines.
ex.t: 无人机在检查电力线方面的应用。

defs.def: to find out if sth/sb is present, correct or true or if sth is how you think it is 查明；查看；核实；弄确实

ex.s: This kind of planned revisit could also be for confirming certain details in the text, or for checking on the moves of a given character.
ex.t: 这种有计划的重读也可以是为了确认文本中的某些细节，或者查看某个特定人物的动向。

ex.s: Check the map.
ex.t: 查看地图。

ex.s: My mother was not afraid of Mrs Calloway She wished me to have my own library card to check out books for myself.
ex.t: 我妈妈不害怕Calloway太太她希望我有自己的借书证可以自己借书。

ex.s: Check out that girl over there.
ex.t: 看看那边的那个女孩。

ex.s: Check the train schedule.
ex.t: 查看火车时刻表。

ex.s: Check the train schedule.
ex.t: 查看火车时刻表。

ex.s: My friends checked and came back shouting, “Amy, you got the main role! ” Sure enough, my name was at the top.
ex.t: 我的朋友们查看后跑回来喊道："艾米，你拿到主角了！"果然，我的名字在最上面。

ex.s: Stories were like air to me and while other kids played ball or went to parties, I lived out adventures through the books I checked out from the library.
ex.t: 故事对我来说就像空气一样，当其他孩子在打球或参加派对时，我从图书馆借阅的书本中体验着冒险。

ex.s: I checked out a half dozen books on Paul Revere from the library.
ex.t: 我从图书馆借了六七本关于保罗·里维尔的书。

ex.s: I checked out a half dozen books on Paul Revere from the library.
ex.t: 我从图书馆借了六七本关于保罗·里维尔的书。

ex.s: According to Paragraph 3, what items may be checked out from a public library? （    ）
ex.t: 根据第3段，哪些物品可以从公共图书馆借出？（    ）

ex.s: I checked the embassy website and we don’t need to apply for a visa now.
ex.t: 我查了大使馆网站，我们现在不需要申请签证了。

defs.def: to control sth; to stop sth from increasing or getting worse 控制；抑制；阻止

ex.s: The fur trade kept nutria check for decades，but when the market for nutria collapsed in the late 1980s，the cat-sized animals multiplied like crazy.
ex.t: 皮草贸易使海狸鼠的数量得到控制了几十年，但20世纪80年代末海狸鼠市场崩溃后，这种猫大小的动物疯狂繁殖。

defs.def: to stop yourself from saying or doing sth or from showing a particular emotion 克制，抑制（做某事或表露感情）
to leave coats, bags, etc. in an official place (called a checkroom ) while you are visiting a club, restaurant, etc. 存放；寄放
to leave bags or cases with an official so that they can be put on a plane or train 托运（行李）

ex.s: Don’t forget to check in online and print your boarding pass in advance.
ex.t: 别忘了在线办理登机手续，并提前打印您的登机牌。

defs.def: to put a mark (✓) next to an item on a list, an answer, etc. 标记号；打上钩；打对号
to find out if sth is correct, or if sb is acceptable 调查；查证；核实

ex.s: Instructors are passionate educators who are experts in their fields and have undergone training and a background check.
ex.t: 指导员是充满热情的教育工作者，是他们领域的专家，并经过了培训和背景调查。

defs.def: to look at or examine a person or thing that seems interesting or attractive 察看，观察（有趣或有吸引力的人或事物）

ex.s: A policeman who is checking the area sees a man outside a shop.
ex.t: 一名正在检查该区域的警察看到商店外有一个男人。

ex.s: We bravely drove off again two hours later after we’d returned home to get the purse and traveler’s checks Mom had forgotten.
ex.t: 第2段： 我们穿过几个州，沿途看到了很多美景。

defs.def: an act of making sure that sth is safe, correct or in good condition by examining it 检查，查看（是否安全、正确、状况良好）

ex.s: go through a security check first
ex.t: 先经过安全检查

ex.s: Let’s get started by checking out Student Guide for your academic journey!
ex.t: 让我们先来看看《学生指南》，开启你的学术之旅吧！

defs.def: an investigation to find out more information about sth 调查；审查
something that delays the progress of sth else or stops it from getting worse 阻碍进程的事物；阻止恶化的事物
rules that are designed to control the amount of power, especially political power, that one person or group has （对政治等权力的）规定，条令，约束
a pattern of squares, usually of two colours （通常指双色的）方格图案，方格，格子
the bill for sth, for example in a restaurant （餐馆等的）账单

ex.s: Interlibrary Loan (ILL) provides teachers, students and staff with access to books that are checked out or not owned by our own libraries, as well as digitized copies of articles and book chapters from our collection.
ex.t: 馆际互借（ILL）为教师、学生和工作人员提供借阅已借出或本馆未收藏的图书的渠道，以及本馆收藏的文章和书籍章节的数字副本。

defs.def: a place in a club, restaurant, etc. where you can leave your coat or bag （俱乐部、餐馆等外套、包的）寄存处，存放处
a ticket that you get when you leave your coat, bag, etc. in, for example, a restaurant or theatre （餐馆或剧院等的）存物牌，存放证
a position in which a player's king (= the most important piece) can be directly attacked by the other player's pieces 国际象棋

ex.s: He is most probably checking whether everything is OK.
ex.t: 他很可能在更换灯泡。

defs.def: a mark (✓) put beside a sum or an item on a list, usually to show that it has been checked or done or is correct 核对号；对号；钩号
